 After rumours it will end soon, beloved spy show Slow Horses confirms future with big announcement 
 It's not over just yet.
 By Stefania Sarrubba Published: 16 November 2026 %0A%09<path d="M240,128a15.74,15.74,0,0,1-7.6,13.51L88.32,229.65a16,16,0,0,1-16.2.3A15.86,15.86,0,0,1,64,216.13V39.87a15.86,15.86,0,0,1,8.12-13.82,16,16,0,0,1,16.2.3L232.4,114.49A15.74,15.74,0,0,1,240,128Z">%0A</path></svg>" width="60" height="60" alt="Play video"/> Slow Horses is entering Game of Thrones territory, as the Mick Herron adaptation has just confirmed its future after speculation that it would end following season 8.
 Developed by British comedian Will Smith, the spy series following the group of MI5 underdogs is now officially returning for two additional seasons on top of the previously greenlit seasons 7 and 8. That means the show has been renewed up to season 10. 
 Seasons 7 and 8 will be adapted from Herron's most recent Slough House novels, 2022's Bad Actors and 2025's Clown Town , leaving seasons 9 and 10 without a definite source material to draw from. 
 Apple TV Related: Best streaming services UK 2026 – including Disney Plus, Netflix, iPlayer and Apple TV 
 It is not clear at present whether the new seasons would turn to Herron's collection of Slough House short stories, 2026's Watch the Quiet Snow , or continue without the safety net of published material, much like Game of Thrones did after season 5.
 Just last week, returning Slow Horses star Olivia Cooke appeared to reveal that the eighth season would be the show's last when speaking with The Times .
 What to Read Next
 "I am shooting the last season!" the Sid Baker star said. "Never say never. But I think that's what we've been told and it definitely feels like we are ending. We're all melancholy, distracted. Yesterday, I got in the make-up chair and cried."
 Now, it seems that fans of the show won't have to mourn it just yet, as Apple TV has announced more is in store for the protagonists.
 Apple TV Related: Slow Horses season 6 is its darkest with one of the best and most gripping moments the show has seen 
 However, the streamer hasn't shared the full cast for seasons 9 and 10. At present, Gary Oldman's Jackson Lamb is the only returning character for those seasons amid rumours that Jack Lowden, who plays River Cartwright, is in the final stages of the James Bond casting race .
 Slow Horses seasons 1-6 are streaming on Apple TV now. Seasons 7 and 8 are in production, with two more seasons confirmed.
